{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows where revenue is NaN (due to non-numeric values)
df = df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Filter out rows where converted is 1 but status is not 'completed'
df = df[~((df['converted'] == 1) & (df['status'] != 'completed'))]

# Recalculate conversion rate after cleaning
df_clean = df
conversion_rate_by_segment_final = df_clean.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Output the final conversion rates
conversion_rate_by_segment_final"}
